newsitem.title: USA: Hurco unit to license patent to Giddings.
newsitem.headline: Hurco unit to license patent to Giddings.

text.p: Hurco Cos Inc said Tuesday its subsidiary IMS Technology Inc agreed to a settlement with Giddings & Lewis Inc concerning an IMS patent for certain interactive computer numerical control technologies developed by Hurco.

Under the agreement, IMS will license the patent to Giddings and certain related parties for a one-time cash payment of about $1 million. Hurco said it expects the settlement will add about $650,000 to its net income, net of legal fees and expenses, in its current fiscal year.
The patent is the subject of a number of pending infringement claims and other actions, Hurco said. Giddings was not a party to any of those actions, it said.
HURCO produces computer numerical control systems.
